name: Wasitora
description: The Nekoru queen threatening Sekana, later charged with protecting the village.

description_citations.text: "Tor Wauki the Younger". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The village council calls in Tetsuo to defeat Wasitora; their duel is interrupted by an Elder Land Wurm, whom they defeat together.
timeline.quote: Wasitora and Tetsuo defeat the wurm.

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo rewards Wasitora with the position of champion's deputy and she accepts.

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Meha and the kittens destroy Kentsu forces sent to lure Tetsuo; Bolas robs Overdark of his body in punishment.
timeline.quote: Bolas robs Overdark of the use of his body

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Wasitora routs the legion sent to level Umezawa Manor.
timeline.quote: that group is intercepted and routed by Wasitora

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Weeks later the friends reunite on Sekana and convince Tetsuo to restore order to the empire.
timeline.quote: he sets off to do just that

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo and Kei go to Sekana, where the Nekoru Wasitora agrees to let the Kentsu pass if they avoid her kittens.
timeline.quote: She will if the soldiers stay well away from her newborn kittens.

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Overdark sends Xira Arien to target Umezawa, who is drawn in after defending Sekana from Wasitora.
timeline.quote: Overdark dispatching his minion, the eumidian Xira Arien

citation.text: "Madara-Edemi War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo duels the cat-dragon Wasitora at Sekana; after an Elder Land Wurm interrupts, he spares her and she becomes champion's deputy.
timeline.quote: Wasitora helped kill the creature, and Tetsuo realized he didn't have to kill her.

citation.text: "Tetsuo Umezawa", section "Youth and training". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo hides on the Meditation Plane while Wasitora's kittens destroy a kentsu regiment sent to Sekana.
timeline.quote: The regiment was destroyed by Wasitora's kittens

citation.text: "Tetsuo Umezawa", section "Champion against emperor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Wasitora learns she is a nekoru, wins the contest of nekoru, declares herself queen and chooses Mayonako, then decides to raise her kittens away from her kind.
timeline.quote: Wasitora proves herself the strongest female and declares herself their queen.

citation.text: "The Monsters of Magic", section "Who Is Queen? , by Scott McGough". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the start of the Madara-Edemi War, Tor travels to Sekana, meets elder Bejahn and fails to parley with Wasitora, who breaks his bow.
timeline.quote: but the nekoru simply broke his bow and scratched his chest with a lightning-quick swipe.

citation.text: "Tor Wauki the Younger", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An Elder Land Wurm announces the Edemi rebellion and the group together kills it.
timeline.quote: teamed up against the wurm and managed to kill it.

citation.text: "Tor Wauki the Younger", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
